scope: Read-only bounded representation audit of frozen proposal8/current v21 inputs. No source motion, native anatomy, ranges, gains, capacities or gates changed. Shared-forearm constant placement cleanup is identity-only.

clinicalTolerance.interpretation: Reported numerical excess is within the existing tolerance; it is not independently a clinical failure.

findings: Hand-local axial twist can be transferred around the actual elbow-wrist axis while holding joint centers and palm orientation, without inventing an independent anatomical wrist rotation.
The existing Euler/swing decomposition total pronation readout changes by up to1.48 degrees under this redistribution; treating local components as a geometric invariant would be false.
Actual forearm skin changes up to30.94mm. A rigid native forearm and a distributed source twist are not identical contact geometry even when endpoint frames match.
After axial redistribution, source elbow off-axis rotations remain unrepresented by the two-axis native forearm, reaching8.496 degrees in setup.

Native humeral engineering serial-hinge stop is not the engine clinical humerothoracic range nor its coupled120-degree glenohumeral proxy bound. The validated source is ordinary clinical elevation but an overhead-derived local hinge value is truncated.

recommendation.nextBoundedStep: Author a common arm representation in Blender with actual centerline twist, a two-axis wrist, and explicit ownership of bounded elbow carrying-angle/play. Audit clinical readouts and actual skin before source promotion. Resolve native shoulder feasibility in that same shared anatomical frame; do not copy clinical numeric ranges onto unrelated native Euler coordinates.
recommendation.sourceOption: Use existing arm DOFs for closed-chain support with true forearm rotation and two-axis wrist; retain existing clinical/patient constraints, all skin/contact gates, and report infeasible cases. Off-axis elbow play may need a passive native coordinate or source-authoring constraint, with explicit semantics and existing bounds.
recommendation.nativeOption: Map distributed radioulnar twist geometrically with a declared intermediate forearm material frame. Compare source centerline plus distal palm separately from material-axis twist, and preserve collider/skin residuals. Never suppress orientation evidence or silently reclassify a changed surface as exact source.
recommendation.unresolved: No native runtime correction is promoted by this audit. Fresh source requires new capture, native trials and full-step tracking; timestep/repeatability remain pending while tracking fails.
